messages:
maria: CI perf alert — nightly perf job on euw2 H100 shows p99 +42% after yesterday's merge. KV cache miss rate up ~3x. Canaries: one group degraded. attaching flamegraphs and basic logs :eyes:

ci-bot: ALERT perf-test/e2e-euw2-h100 job=perf-euw2-h100-7821 p99=180ms (baseline 126ms) status=regression

jonathan: any likely PRs? the last big one was PR 4912 (kernel-selector: threshold tuning + reuse heuristic).

maria: reproduced locally on an H100 slice with same image. profile shows extended time in select_kernel_v2 + a surprising spike in NIC poll syscalls. flame snippet:

```
select_kernel_v2  48%
kv_cache_lookup    12%
kernel_dispatch    22%
sys_epoll_wait      5%
sys_io_poll         8%
```

lee: odd that it's H100-only. perf matrix for A10/L4 looks normal. maybe the selector's threshold pushes H100 into an alternate execution path (batch packing changes) that increases small-packet networking.

ashley: KV cache eviction rate doubled in the failing runs. kvcache.evictions/sec went from ~120 -> ~330. traced a few requests, prefixes that used to hit are now missing — suggests shard/placement behavior changed or cache keying variance after kernel pick.

priya: can we bisect to a single commit? if PR4912 is suspect start there.

maria: ran a quick bisect across the last 8 merges. culprit appears to be commit 7f3c2d4 (kernel-selector: tighten threshold + reuse heuristic). reverting that commit locally drops p99 back to baseline and kvcache evictions return to normal.

jonathan: OK put a rollout hold on the canary and prepare a revert. @eng-releases please coordinate a rollback and stop wider rollout :hammer:

devops-bot: Rollout hold applied to canary euw2-h100 group. Autoscale adjustments paused.

maria: opening revert PR and running wall-of-perf across regions/hardware. also adding targeted nettrace to understand the syscalls surge — suspect kernel packing changed request batching which increased epoll wakeups. command i'm running:

```bash
./perf-run --slice euw2-h100 --job perf-euw2-h100 --collect flame,kvcache,nettrace --runs 5
```

lee: FYI one node in slice-3 reported noisy neighbor (high RDMA traffic from another tenant) around the same window, but correlation only appears after the kernel-selector change landed. so likely a two-factor issue: selector change made us more sensitive to NIC contention. recommend revert + staged rollout with extra net tracing.

ashley: opened revert PR #4938 (revert 7f3c2d4) and added extra kvcache metrics + nettrace flags to the perf harness. link: https://git.internal/reviews/4938 (will add perf artifacts).

maria: thanks — assigning release window to jonathan. i'll post final perf runs and nettrace summary here once complete.

jonathan: thanks team. after revert lands we'll run a short canary (48h) and then reintroduce a softer threshold change with telemetry flags.

maria: noted — leaving the thread pinned for artifacts. :white_check_mark:
